create.name: Whitney Durrant
create.bio:
Whitney Durrant is a yoga and meditation teacher and Reiki practitioner based in Oregon. She has taught yoga since 2014 and holds the Yoga Alliance E-RYT 200 credential, with Reiki training to the second level in the Usui tradition. A former public school teacher, she left classroom work to teach English in Thailand, then spent several years living in South-East Asia and house-sitting around Europe before settling in Eugene in 2020. That period of travel shapes Moon Wandering, the website through which she shares her teaching, and her interest in the local spiritual customs of the places she visits.

Her work blends gentle and flowing yoga, guided meditation and energy practice organised around the chakras, with a particular fondness for rituals timed to the new and full moon. She offers distance Reiki sessions over Zoom or as a personalised recorded meditation, on a sliding scale, and sells a short self-paced root chakra course with a workbook, yoga sequences and meditations. She speaks openly about honouring the roots of yoga and the cultures it comes from. On Insight Timer she has published guided meditations, affirmations and moon-themed practices, and her YouTube channel holds a set of recorded yoga classes and meditations.

courses.title: Distance Reiki Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Reiki in the Usui tradition, given entirely online. You choose either a live session that ends with a Zoom conversation or a recorded meditation made for you, which you keep. Priced on a sliding scale.

courses.title: Root Chakra Healing Kit
courses.description: A self-paced course on caring for the base chakra, built from an ebook, a workbook, yoga practices and meditations. It is aimed at people who want more steadiness and a closer link with the earth element.

courses.title: Meditate With The Moon
courses.description: Her Insight Timer course built around the cycle of the moon, with short practices to follow through the month.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Whitney Durrant on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations, Reiki-infused affirmations and moon practices, free to hear in the Insight Timer app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Quickstart Guide to Balancing the Root Chakra
free_resources.description: A free article on her site with simple practices and small rituals she uses to feel grounded and steady.

free_resources.title: Five-Minute Full Moon Rituals
free_resources.description: Short rituals for the full moon that fit into a busy day, written up free on her blog.
